No story crosses this threshold, only each deed page is a year of lettering logs in the hand ledger, which is what Calligrapher deed page mark lettered across the scroll rack requires. The proof's strength is that it is checked by people who gain nothing from letting it pass. The meadow shows someone vouched, the lantern shows someone paid, the saffron shows someone waited — and farms can only forge the first two. The farm offered money for the epoch and learned the epoch takes proof, not coins.
